transactions.desc: Bratt was added to the active roster as the 27th man for Saturday's doubleheader against the Giants. He will start Game 2.
The Diamondbacks selected Law's contract from Triple-A Reno on Saturday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Drake to Triple-A Reno on Saturday.
The Giants selected Lonsway's contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Saturday.
The Giants optioned Bivens to Triple-A Sacramento on Saturday.
Wilkinson was added to the active roster as the 27th man for Saturday's doubleheader against the Diamondbacks and will start Game 1.
The Cardinals designated Ferguson for assignment Saturday.
The Cardinals recalled Mautz from Triple-A Memphis on Saturday.
The Marlins optioned Monteverde to Triple-A Jacksonville on Saturday.
The Marlins recalled Gonzalez from Triple-A Jacksonville on Saturday.
The Mets optioned Wagaman to Triple-A Syracuse on Saturday.
The Mets reinstated Soto (calf) from the injured list Saturday, Will Sammon of The Athletic reports.
The Yankees added Beck to their active roster as the 27th man for Saturday's doubleheader against the Red Sox.
The Red Sox added Burgos to the active roster as the 27th man for Saturday's doubleheader against the Yankees.
The Red Sox optioned Olds to Triple-A Worcester on Saturday.
The Red Sox reinstated Whitlock (elbow) from the injured list Saturday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Burgos to Triple-A Reno on Friday.
The Diamondbacks recalled Drake from Triple-A Reno ahead of his start Friday against the Giants.
The Orioles optioned Vazquez to Triple-A Norfolk on Friday.
The Orioles reinstated Alexander (hand) from the injured list Friday.
The Cubs placed Milner on outright waivers Friday, Mark Feinsand of MLB.com reports.
The Angels optioned Teodosio to Triple-A Salt Lake on Friday.
The Angels reinstated Meckler (concussion) from the injured list Friday.
The Athletics optioned Rom to Triple-A Las Vegas on Friday.
The Athletics reinstated Suarez (hip) from the 15-day injured list Friday.
The Cardinals recalled Saggese from Triple-A Memphis on Friday.
The Twins optioned Roden to Triple-A St. Paul on Friday.
The Twins selected Jenkins' contract from Triple-A St. Paul on Friday.
The Rangers recalled Macko from Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Blue Jays recalled Van Eyk from Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
